fusions.name: Skirmisher's Loose
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows on the run, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage. Their damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%. Holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Supine Draw
fusions.desc: Lies back and draws the bow with your feet for 1.5 seconds, then looses a shot that deals 36 damage to the first enemy it meets, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Kiting Step
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 4 tiles away, and your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Nocked on the Move
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
